description: Somos un equipo lleno de curiosidad, entusiasmo y uchas ganas de aprender, nos otiva descubrir coo funciona nuestro planeta explorar nuevas ideas, investigar, trabajar en equipo y convertir nuestras ideas en proyectos innovadores. Estamos dispuestos a aprender porque cada descubrimiento comienza con una pregunta y cada logro con el deseo de aprender.
summary: In this project, we are looking to find new interactive and fun ways for kids to spark their interest in science for the new generations, promoting its importance through dynamic games. we hope you like it
details: We want to spark kids' interest in science and space exploration. We hope more kids get curious about learning about the universe and see how space missions work. It lets kids learn about space in a fun way. It also develops their curiosity, logical thinking, and problem-solving skills. It's creative because we turn learning about space into an adventure. Instead of just reading information or answering questions, kids have to explore, look for materials, and overcome obstacles to complete a mission. We mainly took into account the children's age, that the game was easy to use, that the activities were short and fun, and that the scientific information was educational and easy to understand. and we use GOOGLE AI STUDIO. THANKS!
